about.title: Identity and Professional Philosophy
about.description: Connecting the logic of physical systems with digital frontend environments to resolve complex administrative bottlenecks.
about.bio: I am a Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer who believes technology should serve people. Beyond coding, I am a teacher, a researcher, and a lifelong learner. I find joy in mentoring students, exploring new technologies, and contributing to open-source projects. My work is driven by a desire to build solutions that are not only efficient and scalable but also meaningful and accessible. I strive to bridge complex systems with human needs, always keeping the end-user at the center of every decision.
about.philosophy: I believe in building software that is maintainable, robust, and accessible. Whether designing databases or lecturing on algorithms, my focus is always on solving structural problems rather than applying superficial fixes.

experience.description: Designing end-to-end full-stack applications with React/Django. Conducting peer-reviewed research in system optimizations, and lecturing in technical curriculum courses.

Lectured on Systems Engineering courses including programming fundamentals, robotics, data structures, and technology project development. Designed didactic strategies combining theory with lab practices and collaborative projects. Served as thesis advisor and evaluator for research work in related disciplines.

Delivered theoretical and practical robotics training to elementary and high school students, covering programming, electronics, and 3D design fundamentals. Guided students in developing functional prototypes from simulated environments.

Taught STEAM subjects to elementary students through interdisciplinary projects integrating science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics. Designed robotics and electronics activities using Arduino and Tinkercad, and led project-based learning initiatives connected to culture, environment, and entrepreneurship.

Planned and delivered theoretical-practical robotics classes for students at various levels. Designed educational activities using Tinkercad for circuit simulation, Scratch for basic programming, and 3D modeling. Provided personalized mentorship to facilitate understanding of complex concepts.
Graduated with honors. Developed an automated Human Capital Management (HCM) platform as an undergraduate thesis to resolve university operations deficits.

Provided technical support on internal platforms, administrative systems, and personnel databases, ensuring their operability and constant updating. Collaborated in administrative processes and staff support, and participated in institutional events, social activities, and community projects.
Analyzed administrative operational pipelines, gathered systems requirements, and mapped internal organizational structures to optimize HR documentation processes.

overview.title: Human Capital Management System
overview.description: A comprehensive Human Capital Management platform developed to optimize the administrative processes of the Human Resources Department at Universidad de Margarita.

problem.title: A complex administrative environment
problem.description: The Human Resources Department handled several processes through fragmented workflows, manual documentation, and disconnected information sources. This increased processing times, duplicated information, and made it difficult to obtain reliable data for decision-making.

solution.title: A centralized HCM ecosystem
solution.description: The project proposes a centralized web platform that integrates Human Resources processes into a unified digital environment, allowing information to be managed consistently while providing administrators with tools for monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and decision-making.

objectives.title: Process Optimization
objectives.description: Reduce unnecessary administrative operations through structured and automated digital workflows.

objectives.title: Information Centralization
objectives.description: Provide a centralized environment for managing personnel-related information and organizational processes.

objectives.title: Decision Support
objectives.description: Provide structured information and indicators that support administrative analysis and decision-making.

architecture.title: A modular full-stack architecture
architecture.description: The platform follows a modular architecture that separates the presentation, application logic, API services, and data persistence layers.
